lines.zh: 我不能走，我只能挂在叶下。
lines.en: I can't walk; I can only hang beneath a leaf.
I sway in the wind, faintly.

lines.zh: 我靠一根丝吊着，微微动。
lines.en: I hang by a thread of silk and stir slightly.

lines.zh: 叶子翻面时，我跟着翻身。
lines.en: When the leaf turns, I turn with it.
My shell is hard; I can't move.

lines.zh: 我轻轻地蹭了一下叶脉。
lines.en: I brush the vein once, lightly.
I swing slowly under the leaf.
When the wind rises, I grip my thread.
I'm not walking; I'm being rocked.

lines.zh: 叶影移过去，我也跟着暗。
lines.en: The leaf's shadow passes, and I darken.

lines.zh: 我贴着叶面，几乎不占地方。
lines.en: I cling to the leaf, taking almost no room.

lines.zh: 我转了个角度，让雨滑下去。
lines.en: I turn so the rain slides off.
The wind turns me gently.

lines.zh: 我在叶下摆了一下，又停。
lines.en: I swing once under the leaf and stop.

lines.zh: 叶柄动了，我跟着挪了半寸。
lines.en: The stem moves; I shift half an inch.

lines.zh: 我一点一点收紧那根丝。
lines.en: I take up the thread little by little.
I hang motionless like a curled leaf.
Something inside is slowly changing.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上有细小的纹。
lines.en: Fine lines run over my shell.

lines.zh: 我听见鸟在附近，不出声。
lines.en: I hear a bird nearby and stay silent.
I wind my silk a little tighter.
I remember being a caterpillar.
I wait for the inside to finish.
The sun makes my shell gleam.

lines.zh: 我里面在动，你不一定看得见。
lines.en: Something moves inside; you may not see it.

lines.zh: 我挂在这里已经好几天了。
lines.en: I've hung here for days.

lines.zh: 下雨的时候我把自己收紧。
lines.en: When it rains, I draw myself in.
I neither feed nor drink.

lines.zh: 你看见我了？我装得很像叶子。
lines.en: You saw me? I pass for a leaf well.
Don't touch me; I'm busy changing.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我就在你头顶的叶下。
lines.en: You look up; I'm under the leaf above you.

lines.zh: 你凑近看，我的壳是硬的。
lines.en: Look closer; my shell is hard.

lines.zh: 你要等的话，就多等几天。
lines.en: If you'll wait, wait a few more days.

lines.zh: 我记得你手上有叶子的味道。
lines.en: I remember your hands smelled of leaves.
You're blocking the light; step aside.

lines.zh: 我现在不能跑，也不能躲。
lines.en: I can't run now, and I can't hide.

lines.zh: 你别把我从叶上摘下来。
lines.en: Don't pick me off the leaf.
I hang too high for you to reach.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂开，缝一直延到叶柄。
lines.en: My shell has split; the crack runs to the leaf stem.
I swing a long while before settling.

lines.zh: 壳里的我绷紧，又慢慢松开。
lines.en: Inside my shell I tense, then slowly loosen.
The thread holding me has slackened.
I hang at the leaf's edge; it's risky.
That slowed my changing.
I cling to the leaf and wait it out.
I hear a sound inside my shell.
I mustn't move; moving would end it.
I'm still hanging; don't worry.

lines.zh: 叶子离我很近，可我吃不了。
lines.en: The leaf is close, but I can't eat.
I feel the light; it's good.
Pull the branch a little lower.
A water bead slides by; I catch it.
I smell tender leaves and can only smell.
Don't pick me; I'm not ready.
Wait a while; let it get brighter.

lines.zh: 我需要安静，风小一点更好。
lines.en: I need quiet; less wind is better.
I'll take that bit of rain.
I lean a little toward the light.

lines.zh: 你碰了一下，我晃得厉害。
lines.en: One touch from you and I swing hard.
My silk pulls taut and holds.
I slide from the underside to the edge.

lines.zh: 你撞到树枝，我转了一圈。
lines.en: You hit the branch; I spin once.

lines.zh: 我撞在叶面上，硬壳没事。
lines.en: I knock against the leaf; the shell holds.
You blow, and I start swinging.

lines.zh: 我们碰上，你听见一声轻响。
lines.en: We touch, and you hear a faint click.
I settle back under the leaf.
You've rocked me dizzy.
I hang by my thread and won't fall.

lines.zh: 另一枚蛹挂在旁边的叶下。
lines.en: Another chrysalis hangs under the next leaf.
We face each other across the vein.
Her shell is darker.

lines.zh: 我们的丝缠在同一根枝上。
lines.en: Our threads meet on the same twig.
She pupated two days before me.
We sway in the wind together.
There's a scratch on her shell.

lines.zh: 我们都不说话，里面在忙。
lines.en: Neither speaks; the work is inside.

lines.zh: 她的影子落在我的叶上。
lines.en: Her shadow falls on my leaf.

lines.zh: 等我们都出来，就一起飞。
lines.en: When we both emerge, we'll fly together.

lines.zh: 我接住一滴露水，慢慢吸。
lines.en: I catch a dewdrop and draw it in.
I pull my silk up a little.
I catch a drifting fleck of leaf.

lines.zh: 我的壳上落了点灰，擦不掉。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shell; I can't wipe it.

lines.zh: 我把一根细丝绕到枝上。
lines.en: I wrap a fine thread around the twig.

lines.zh: 我捞起一片花瓣，贴在身边。
lines.en: I catch a petal and keep it beside me.
I hold onto a drifting fibre.
I catch a raindrop; it's cold.
I draw the leaf's edge closer.

lines.zh: 我接住你吹过来的东西。
lines.en: I catch what you blew over.
That leaf's underside suits better.
I want to shift that way a little.
I feel the wind change.
A shadow is coming.
I must hold my thread tight.
There's light over there; I need light.
I hear something chewing leaves.
I've fixed on that spot.

lines.zh: 我朝那根更粗的枝偏过去。
lines.en: I lean toward the sturdier twig.

lines.zh: 我要在天黑前安定下来。
lines.en: I want to settle before dark.
I slowly turn my back.
I judge the distance to that light.
Wind comes; I tighten my silk.
That shadow stays.

lines.zh: 它一走开，我就能安心变。
lines.en: Once it leaves, I can change in peace.
My shell is beginning to clear.

lines.zh: 我里面的东西在往上顶。
lines.en: Something inside presses upward.
Almost; nearly done.
I don't move; moving would drop me.
I shift my weight a little.
I knock the leaf with my shell.
I swing on my silk and hit it.
I bump the blocking leaf loose.
My shell is hard; it hurts itself.

lines.zh: 我荡过去撞它，壳比它硬。
lines.en: I swing into it; my shell is harder.
I jerk once and break free of a thread.
That knock leaves me dizzy.
I shove with my shell and push it off.
It falls; I don't move.
I retreat under the leaf; I'm fine.

lines.zh: 毛虫在叶上结了丝，我成形了。
lines.en: The caterpillar spun silk; now I'm formed.
I hang under the leaf, soft at first.

lines.zh: 外壳慢慢变硬，颜色变深。
lines.en: My shell hardens and darkens.
The leaf has become my roof.
I hang in midair without a stir.

lines.zh: 平原的风把我吹得轻轻响。
lines.en: The plains wind makes me click softly.
A thread still trails from me.
I hear footsteps below.

lines.zh: 光透进来，我在暗里数日子。
lines.en: Light seeps in; I count the days in the dark.

lines.zh: 我要在这里待上一段日子。
lines.en: I'll stay here some days.

lines.zh: 热气贴上我的壳，边缘开始发白。
lines.en: Heat presses on my shell; the rim goes pale.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉下去，摔在草上。
lines.en: I fall from the leaf onto the grass.

lines.zh: 水浸过来，我在壳里憋着。
lines.en: Water soaks in; I cramp inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我被掀得乱转，丝还缠着叶。
lines.en: I spin wildly, silk still wound round the leaf.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过壳，留下一道白痕。
lines.en: An arrow grazes the shell, leaving a white mark.

lines.zh: 有光罩住我，里面更暗了。
lines.en: A light covers me, and inside grows darker.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，但里面越来越空。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet I grow emptier inside.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我听见壳在响。
lines.en: The lightning is so bright I hear my shell ring.

lines.zh: 丝还在，叶子没了，我一直坠。
lines.en: My thread remains, the leaf is gone, and I fall.
